news.title: Bitcoin loses grip near $80,000 as ETH, SOL, DOGE fade on profit-taking
news.summary: Bitcoin traded at $77,794 on Thursday morning, up 0.4% over 24 hours but well off the $79,388 high hit Wednesday evening, with ether, XRP and Solana all closing red.

news.title: Cardano builder seeks smaller funding slice of $46.8 million for scaling and Bitcoin DeFi
news.summary: The engineering organization behind Cardano submitted nine proposals totaling $46.8 million for the 2026 voting cycle, down from $97.5 million last year.

news.title: Bitcoin's bull score index just left bear territory. There's a warning attached.
news.summary: The index has returned to neutral territory, a rare milestone that has historically marked market turning points, but not always correctly.

news.title: Coinbase backer Blockchain Capital hunts $700 million for new funds
news.summary: The San Francisco-based firm is raising for its seventh early-stage fund and second growth fund, which are expected to be completed in the next five to six months.

news.title: The DAT collapse: Pantera wants Satsuma to dump its bitcoin as shares crash 99%
news.summary: Pantera Capital is urging London-listed Satsuma Technology to liquidate its remaining bitcoin holdings and return cash to shareholders.

news.title: More than 100 crypto firms urge Senate to move on U.S. market structure bill
news.summary: Key priorities include defining clear SEC and CFTC oversight roles, protecting non-custodial developers, simplifying disclosure rules, and avoiding a patchwork of state laws.

news.title: Bitcoin slips from near $80,000 as oil price increase weighs on risk assets
news.summary: Bitcoin dips after testing $80,000 as oil surges and traders stay bearish, even though a breakout hints the rally could accelerate on short squeezes.

news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
